title: 第二十章 开始指导第六章 前朝后宫
lines: 作为傀儡，朝会和左墟其实是没啥关系。
他的任务就是坐在龙椅上，然后盖个章就行了。
好处大家享，锅他来背。
他要是敢发表什么高论，下朝后就会被太后派来的太监围起来圈踢，在物质和精神上进行鞭挞，还会被以孝义的大棒给打的昏头转向。
所以朝会这种东西。
圣天子其实是有些反感的。
当然了，没有朝会的日子不代表昭明帝就好过了。
在过去当皇帝当的极为憋屈的他，凡事都要小心翼翼，怕违背了哪条规矩。
每日都要去仁寿宫给太后请安。
去请安可不是简单问好然后唠嗑唠嗑走人，而是要接受孝义经典的询问，还有装模作样的议政见解，说白了就是疯狂打击昭明帝的自信，让他变得唯唯诺诺，不管是做什么都瞻前顾后不自信。
然后还要锐评一句：望之不似人君！
这样被废掉的时候自然是不会有什么阻力。
除此之外。
理论上昭明帝唯一能找到慰藉和助力的地方，也就是他的妻子，也早早就被安排好了，过去也是没有什么帮助，反倒是要被训来训去，听什么嫡嫡道道的废话。
现在呢？
哈！这些都没有啦！！
睡到日上三竿的圣天子根本无人敢过来打扰。
就算是平日里最嚣张的太后身边那批人，今天是都远远避着坤宁宫，仿佛那里夜宿的不是往日可以随意训斥的昭明帝，而是巨大可怖的凶兽，他一旦睡醒就会和他的爪牙在皇宫里开始挑人吃！
这么说倒也没错。
云鬓花颜金步摇，芙蓉帐暖度春宵。春宵苦短日高起，从此君王不早朝。
一晚上的征伐对圣天子来说强度和日常散步差不多。
但是对于死去活来的雪梅和花蝶来说并非如此。
反正圣天子雄赳赳气昂昂去洗漱用早膳的时候，两位大宫女还在魂飞天外，少说没几个小时是醒不来的。
如此超凡绝伦的战斗力。
还有昨晚冬暖阁声嘶力竭的惨叫。
今天早上圣天子身边的宫女们眼神都清澈了许多，虽然还是热切期盼，但肯定要认真思考一下自己有没有两位大宫女能打。
要知道雪梅是以剑舞闻名，练剑舞不只是体力好身体柔韧性自然不用多说，而花蝶在宫正司干活也是体力充沛意志坚定。
她们都挺不住。
命不要了？
诶！还真有命不要的！
“你叫什么名字？”
享用羊肉粥、炒鸡蛋、面筋炖菜的早膳套餐，左墟饶有兴致的打量着给他布菜的宫女。
同样是大宫女。
虽然有些腿软哆嗦，这位身上有着明显烟火气，全身包裹严实的宫女，还是努力笨拙的展示着自己的才艺见识，布菜时讲解食材鲜嫩和烹饪手法，搭配她的难掩优质的玲珑身段倒是羞涩可餐。
直接给狗皇帝物质精神都吃爽了，妥妥一昏君的模样。
“回圣上，妾，妾名丹娘……”丹娘语气怯生生，未语面先红。
“名字倒是贴切。”圣天子调笑道。
她身上的白裙黑绣，绣的是牡丹花，黑牡丹是牛的雅称，所以也可以喊丹娘是母牛……咳咳，圣天子绝对没有联想到这一层！
不过圣天子也是惊叹。
这大曜朝的宫女伙食这么好么？
content_en:
As puppets, Chaohui and Zuoxu actually have nothing to do with each other.
His task is to sit on the dragon throne and get a seal.
Everyone enjoys the benefits, and he takes the blame.
If he dared to make any lofty remarks, he would be surrounded and kicked by the eunuchs sent by the Queen Mother, and whipped materially and mentally. He would also be beaten with a big stick of filial piety until he was stunned.
So there is such a thing as a morning meeting.
The Holy Emperor was actually a little disgusted.
Of course, the days without court meetings did not mean that Emperor Zhaoming had an easy life.
In the past, he was extremely frustrated when he was the emperor. He had to be careful in everything, fearing that he would violate any rules.
Every day I go to Renshou Palace to pay my respects to the Queen Mother.
Going to greet Emperor Zhaoming is not just about saying hello and chatting away, but about accepting Xiaoyi's classic inquiries and pretentious political opinions. To put it bluntly, it is a crazy attack on Emperor Zhaoming's self-confidence, making him submissive and hesitant and unconfident no matter what he does.
Then I would like to make a sharp comment: Looking at someone is not like a human being!
Naturally there will be no resistance when it is abolished like this.
besides.
Theoretically, the only place where Emperor Zhaoming could find solace and help was in his wife, who had been arranged long ago. In the past, she had not been of much help. Instead, she had to be lectured and listened to the nonsense of the direct descendants.
What now?
ha! None of these! !
No one dared to disturb the Holy Emperor who slept until three o'clock in the morning.
Even the people around the Queen Mother, who are usually the most arrogant, are staying away from Kunning Palace today, as if what stays there at night is not Emperor Zhaoming who can be scolded at will in the past, but a huge and terrifying beast. Once he wakes up, he and his minions will start picking people to eat in the palace!
That's not wrong.
The flowers on the temples are swaying with golden steps, and the hibiscus tent warms the spring night. The spring night is short and the sun is high, and from now on the king will not go to court early.
A night's expedition was about as intense as a daily walk for the Holy Emperor.
But this is not the case for Xuemei and Huadie who have come back to life.
Anyway, when the Holy Emperor went to wash up and have breakfast in a high-spirited manner, the two eldest ladies were still in a daze, and they would not wake up for a few hours at least.
Such extraordinary combat power.
There was also the hoarse scream from Dong Nuan Pavilion last night.
The eyes of the maids around the Holy Emperor this morning were much clearer. Although they were still eagerly looking forward to it, they must seriously consider whether they have two eldest maids who can fight.
You must know that Xuemei is famous for sword dance. Needless to say, practicing sword dance is not only good for physical strength and flexibility, but Huadie is also strong and strong-willed when working in Gong Zhengsi.
They couldn't stand it.
Don't want your life?
Eh! You really don’t want to take your life!
"What's your name?"
Enjoying the breakfast set of mutton porridge, scrambled eggs, and gluten stew, Zuo Xu looked at the palace maid serving him with interest.
The same is true for the palace maid.
Although her legs were weak and trembling, this palace maid with obvious smoky aura and tightly wrapped body still tried her best to show her talent and knowledge clumsily. When serving dishes, she explained the fresh ingredients and cooking techniques, which was quite shy with her exquisite figure that could not hide her high quality.
Directly giving it to the dog emperor made him feel happy both materially and mentally, making him look like a cowardly king.
"Go back to the Holy Spirit, concubine, my name is Danniang..." Danniang's tone was timid, and her face turned red before she spoke.
"The name is quite appropriate." Shengtianzi said with a smile.
The white skirt on her body is embroidered with black peonies. Black peony is the nickname of cow, so you can also call Dan Niang a cow... Ahem, the Holy Emperor definitely did not think of this!
But the Holy Emperor was also amazed.
Is the food of the palace maids of the Great Yao Dynasty so good?
